@graph.name: 4 Day Tumpak Sewu, Bromo & Ijen Adventure from Surabaya to Bali
@graph.description: Private 4-day overland: Surabaya → Tumpak Sewu canyon waterfall → Bromo sunrise → Ijen crater → Bali. All-inclusive. Tourist Police-led operator.

@graph.name: Day 1: Surabaya to the Tumpak Sewu Side
@graph.description: The route opens by moving south from Surabaya toward the Tumpak Sewu side. This first day is about stable positioning for the waterfall segment and the broader eastbound journey ahead.

item.name: Pickup and Transfer to Tumpak Sewu
item.description: Pickup at your location in Surabaya and begin the transfer to the Tumpak Sewu area (Lumajang). This segment is the overland journey from the city to the waterfall area accommodation zone.

item.name: Check-in at Tumpak Sewu Homestay
item.description: Arrive at the Tumpak Sewu area and check in at the homestay/cottage. This is the scheduled arrival and check-in process so you can settle at the accommodation near the Tumpak Sewu area.

@graph.name: Day 2: Tumpak Sewu and Continue Toward the Bromo Side
@graph.description: After the Tumpak Sewu segment, the route continues toward the Bromo side for overnight staging. This day introduces the route's terrain-heavy character before the mountain sequence begins.

item.name: Tumpak Sewu Trekking
item.description: Starting the Tumpak Sewu trekking. Begin the scheduled trekking session at Tumpak Sewu Waterfall, following the planned route on-site to experience the waterfall area during the allocated activity block.

item.name: Lunch
item.description: Lunch at a local restaurant (included). Take the planned lunch break after the trekking session, with time to sit down and eat before the long afternoon transfer.

item.name: Transfer to Mount Bromo Area
item.description: Starting the journey to the Mount Bromo area. Depart from the Tumpak Sewu area and begin the overland transfer to the Mount Bromo accommodation zone as scheduled.

item.name: Check-in at Bromo Hotel
item.description: Arrive at Bromo area and check-in hotel. Reach the Bromo area and complete hotel check-in, concluding the day’s relocation and preparing for the next morning’s Bromo program.

@graph.name: Day 3: Bromo Sunrise and Transfer to the Ijen Side
@graph.description: The third day completes the Bromo sunrise sequence before the route continues east toward the Ijen side. This remains one of the key transfer days and works best when treated as part of the full route logic.

item.name: Bromo Jeep Tour Experience
item.description: Starting the Bromo Jeep tour. Begin the scheduled early-morning Jeep-based Bromo program, following the sunrise tour sequence in the Mount Bromo area within the allocated time window.

item.name: Hotel Breakfast
item.description: Back to the hotel for breakfast. Return from the morning Bromo program to the hotel and take a proper breakfast break before the mid-day check-out and onward transfer.

item.name: Bromo Hotel Check-out
item.description: Check-out hotel. Complete the hotel check-out process and prepare luggage and departure logistics for the overland journey to Bondowoso (Ijen area).

item.name: Transfer to Bondowoso
item.description: Travel to Bondowoso (about 3-4 hours). Start the overland transfer from the Bromo area to Bondowoso, transitioning from the volcanic highlands toward the Ijen-area base town as scheduled.

item.name: Lunch Break (Own Expense)
item.description: Stop for lunch on the way (cost not included). Take a short meal break during the transfer, allowing time to order food and rest briefly before continuing to Bondowoso.

item.name: Transit Stop to Bondowoso Transfer
item.description: Continue the overland journey from the rest stop toward Bondowoso, arriving in time for hotel check-in.

item.name: Bondowoso Hotel Check-in
item.description: Arrive in Bondowoso, check-in hotel. Reach the Bondowoso accommodation and complete the check-in procedure so you can settle in after the transfer day.

item.name: Ijen health screening
item.description: A health screening will be conducted by medical personnel directly at your hotel. This is a quick vital-signs check scheduled as a prerequisite before the Ijen climbing program.

item.name: Included Dinner at Hotel
item.description: Dinner is served at the accommodation (included). Conclude the day with the planned dinner at the hotel, allowing time to rest and recover after an early start and long transfer.

@graph.name: Day 4: Ijen Climb and Finish into Bali
@graph.description: The final day completes the Ijen segment before the route continues through Ketapang and onward into Bali. It is a strong fit for travelers who want the journey to end with a clear cross-island handoff instead of a Surabaya return.

item.name: Hotel check-out and transfer to Ijen
item.description: Check out from the hotel in Bondowoso at midnight and depart for the Ijen trailhead. Travel through the early morning toward Paltuding Base Camp, where the Ijen hiking experience begins.

item.name: Ijen sunrise hike and crater lake viewpoint
item.description: Begin the hike from Paltuding Base Camp toward the Ijen viewpoint. Spend time at the upper viewing area for sunrise, the blue crater lake view, and the surrounding mountain scenery when weather, visibility, and official access conditions allow. Afterwards, descend along the designated trail and return to Paltuding Base Camp.

item.name: Descent to Paltuding Base Camp
item.description: Begin the descent from the upper Ijen viewing area and follow the designated trail back to Paltuding Base Camp. The descent includes sufficient time for a steady walking pace and short stops along the route.

item.name: Short break after the hike
item.description: Short break after Ijen Hike. Use this short recovery window in the Ijen area to rest briefly after the hike, reorganize personal items, and prepare for the onward transfer to the harbor.

item.name: Transfer to Ketapang
item.description: Start the journey to Ketapang Harbor. Depart from the Ijen area and begin the road transfer to Ketapang Harbor to connect with the ferry crossing to Bali.

item.name: Ferry to Gilimanuk Harbor
item.description: Arrive at Ketapang Port and board the ferry. Proceed through the port arrival and boarding flow to begin the ferry crossing toward Gilimanuk Harbor in Bali.

item.name: Arrival at Bali
item.description: Arrive at Gilimanuk Harbor, Bali (+1 hour time zone). Disembark at Gilimanuk and adjust to the time zone difference, completing the crossing segment upon arrival in Bali.

@graph.reviewBody:
(Translated by Google) We booked our three-day trip through the agency: a visit to Temack Sewu, Bromo, and then Ijen. Everything went perfectly. I highly recommend requesting Anjas as your guide. He's fantastic. He did everything he could to make our trip as unforgettable as possible.

(Original)
Nous sommes passé par l’agence pour organiser 3 jours : visite de temack sewu, Bromo puis Ijen. Tous s’est très bien passé. Je vous recommande de demander Anjas comme guide. Il est formidable. Il a tout fait pour que notre voyage soit le plus inoubliable possible.

Great experience with this company, did a 4D3N tumpak sewu, bromo, ijen, madakaripura waterfall tour, was an easy booking process with a well done website, fair price, nice accomodation options with upgrades if desired, nice spacious car for the 4 days, Yusuf was a great driver and was very friendly and helpful, well organised guides for the hikes and seamless 4 days, guides highly recommend to anyone!

What an incredible 4-day adventure exploring some of East Java’s most spectacular destinations! From the volcanic landscapes of Ijen to the breathtaking Tumpak Sewu waterfall and the unforgettable sunrise at Mount Bromo, every day brought a new and amazing experience.
A special thanks to our driver, Fredi, for his exceptional driving skills and for taking such good care of us throughout the trip. He was always friendly, helpful, and had a smile on his face. His positive attitude made the journey even more enjoyable! Highly recommended!

Booked the 4d3n tour to Tumpak Sewu, Mt Bromo and Kawah Ijen from the JVTO website. A really memorable trip with spectacular views, well organised itinerary, decent accommodations and the best tour guides. We always arrived early at the waterfall and mountains to avoid the crowds which is a huge plus point.

Special thanks to Fauzi for taking good care of us the entire trip. He was friendly, hilarious and easy going where we vibed really well with him over common interests and jokes which made the experience even special. He knows all the good picture spots, takes amazing photos and helps us with anything. He was our guide for Tumpak Sewu and Mt Bromo, we always felt safe and never had to worry about anything under his care.

Our driver, Fredy, was always punctual and is also very chill. Although the drives to each destination are long (avg 3-4 hours) each day, his smooth driving makes it comfortable and we slept like a baby during those journeys!

Taufik, our guide at Kawah Ijen was really friendly and professional . He matches our hiking pace and always checked on us. Although we couldn’t head down to see the blue fire, he lit a small flame for us to see which was really nice.

Overall verdict: I highly recommend this tour company if you want a worry-free and unforgettable trip visiting East Java. They always prioritise safety and all the guides and drivers have incredible hospitality and great attitude. Truly a well-organised and fulfilling adventure!

"My Java trip was an unforgettable adventure and one of the highlights of my Indonesia journey. Visiting Ijen Crater was a unique experience, with stunning views of the crater lake and the famous blue flames. The hike was challenging but well worth the effort.
Tumpak Sewu Waterfall was absolutely breathtaking and lived up to its reputation as one of the most beautiful waterfalls in Indonesia. The scenery was spectacular, and the viewpoint offered incredible photo opportunities.
The sunrise at Mount Bromo was magical. Watching the sun rise over the volcanic landscape was an experience I will never forget. The views from the viewpoint and the walk across the sea of sand were amazing.
A special thanks to our travel guide, Dinca, who was professional, friendly, and very knowledgeable throughout the trip. Dinca ensured everything was well organized, shared interesting local insights, and made the journey smooth and enjoyable. His support and attention to detail greatly enhanced our experience.
I highly recommend this Java itinerary to anyone looking for adventure, natural beauty, and unforgettable landscapes. It was a perfect combination of hiking, sightseeing, and cultural experiences."

Guide: Dinca – Highly recommended for a hassle-free and memorable Java adventure.

We joined the 4D3N East Java volcano tour with Java Volcano Tour Operator (JVTO) from April 30 to May 3, 2026, and it was truly an unforgettable experience.

Our driver Fredy was friendly, professional, and very attentive throughout the trip. He safely drove us across East Java and even brought us to a perfect sunrise spot at Bromo.

At Tumpak Sewu, our guide Fusuli was amazing. He carefully guided us through slippery trails, river crossings, and climbing sections while also taking incredible photos and videos for us along the way. At the end, he shared all the edited photos and videos, which left us with wonderful memories of the trip.

For Ijen, our guide Juan was also kind and professional. Even though the blue fire was closed during our visit, we still enjoyed the beautiful crater lake and sunrise. We also had many enjoyable conversations about Indonesian culture during the hike.

From the beginning of the tour until our arrival in Bali, everything was smooth, well organized, and thoughtfully arranged.

We are very happy we chose JVTO and would highly recommend them to anyone planning an East Java volcano adventure.

Just had an amazing time at Ijen, Tumpak Sewu, and Bromo with Mas Kiki- incredible guide, we got a lot of pictures at the best spots!!!! Everything doesn’t feel rushed, very structured too! Our group had the most amazing time with his friendliness, humour, and flexibility.

We had a little hiccup with our first driver and had to change to a different driver midway, but thruought the whole journey, the tour operator was very helpful and quick in responses. We really appreciate it!

Had an amazing trip visiting Bromo, Ijen Crater, and Tumpak Sewu Waterfall! Everything was well organized and the price was really good. The staff were super kind and helpful — special thanks to Yandi (our driver who’s been staying with us the whole trip) and Boy (our guide to Ijen crater). They were so friendly and shared lots of useful info. Even though we had to wake up in the middle of the night, it was totally worth it! Highly recommended

We joined the Bromo–Ijen–Sewu trip with JVTO, and we were lucky to have Rendi and Anjas as our tour guides. They were absolutely amazing! Both of them were clear with their instructions, helpful throughout the journey, and brought such good vibes to the whole experience.

They provided strong emotional support and knew exactly how to connect with our young team. Always friendly, patient, and cheerful, they made a physically demanding trip feel a lot more enjoyable.

If we get the chance to travel with JVTO again, we truly hope Renji and Anjas will be our guides once more. Highly recommended!
